title: Mapúa BS Architecture Comprehensive Exit Exam — 50-Item Master Simulation
description: Full 3-Part PRC Architecture Licensure Examination (ALE) Blueprint Simulation

questions.question: What is the Maximum Allowable Percentage of Site Occupancy (PSO) for an Inside Lot in a C-2 zone without a firewall?
questions.trap: Option A is for R-1 inside lots; Option B is for R-2; Option D is for C-2 corner lots.

questions.question: Under BP 344 Rule II, what is the maximum allowable slope for pedestrian accessibility ramps?
questions.trap: Slopes steeper than 1:12 are strictly illegal under Philippine accessibility standards.

questions.question: Per RA 9514 (Fire Code), what is the occupant load factor for classrooms?
questions.trap: Option A is for auditorium seating; Option B is for dining; Option D is for vocational shops.

questions.question: Under RA 9266 Section 33, who owns the intellectual property and instruments of professional service (plans/specs)?
questions.trap: The Client only purchases the right to build one instance; the RLA retains copyright.

questions.question: Who were the principal architects of the Parthenon in Athens?
questions.trap: Mnesicles designed the Propylaea; Isidore designed Hagia Sophia.

questions.question: In Francis D.K. Ching's ordering principles, a line, plane, or volume that gathers, measures, and organizes disparate spaces is a:
questions.trap: An Axis is a directional centerline; a Datum is the unifying anchor element.

questions.question: What is the minimum compressive strength of concrete required before post-tensioning transfer (f'ci)?
questions.trap: 20.5 MPa prevents localized anchorage crushing during tendon jacking.

questions.question: What is the minimum concrete protective clear cover for footings cast permanently against earth?
questions.trap: 40mm is for interior columns/beams; 75mm is required against raw ground.

questions.question: Under CSI MasterFormat 50-Division System, what is Division 04?
questions.trap: Division 03 = Concrete, Division 04 = Masonry, Division 07 = Moisture, Division 09 = Finishes.

questions.question: Applying NSCP 2015 gravity combination (Wu = 1.2D + 1.6L) for D = 15 kN/m and L = 10 kN/m, what is Wu?
For a simple beam with L = 6.00m carrying uniform load Wu = 34.0 kN/m, what is the maximum midspan moment Mu?
What is the flexural strength reduction factor (phi) for tension-controlled reinforced concrete beams?
questions.trap: 0.65 is for tied columns; 0.90 is for tension-controlled flexural members.

questions.question: What is the standard slope for horizontal plumbing drainage pipes <= 100mm (4 inch) diameter?
questions.trap: 2.0% (1/4 in/ft) is mandatory for 4-inch pipes or smaller to maintain scouring velocity.

questions.question: Per PEC, what is the minimum wire size and breaker rating for general convenience outlets?
questions.trap: Option A is for lighting circuits; Option B is for general receptacle branch circuits.

questions.question: What is 360,000 BTU/hr in Tons of Refrigeration (TR)?
What is the standard guarantee/maintenance period required under UAP Document 301 for latent defects?
questions.trap: 15 years is the Civil Code Article 1723 structural collapse liability; UAP 301 guarantee bond is 1 year.

questions.question: What is the standard dimension for a standard perpendicular off-street car parking slot under PD 1096?
questions.trap: 2.15m x 6.00m is parallel parking; 3.70m x 5.00m is PWD accessible parking.

questions.question: In Philippine tropical architecture, what is the best orientation for habitable spaces and major window openings?
questions.trap: North-South orientation avoids direct morning and afternoon solar heat gain.

questions.question: If a lot has a Total Lot Area of 800 sqm in an R-2 zone with a FLAR of 3.0, what is the Total Gross Floor Area (TGFA)?
questions.trap: TGFA = TLA * FLAR = 800 * 3.0 = 2,400 sqm.

questions.question: A ramp rises 0.60m (600mm). What is the minimum required horizontal ramp run length under BP 344?
